title: Learn the Latest About X-59 and its Mission - Winter 2022
description: In this edition of The Inside Scoop, you’ll learn about NASA's quiet supersonic mission, including the most recent assembly updates, its transport to Fort Worth for critical ground testing, and Armstrong Flight Research Center's new flight simulator upgrades. Plus you'll find out how you and your family and friends can add your name to the X-59's first flight!
